RecommendationTypeEnumQuery.description:
The unique identifier of the recommendation type. Used to classify and group similar recommendations (e.g. 'BRANDED_KEYWORD').
**RecommendationTypeEnum Enum:**
| RecommendationTypeEnum | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `BID` | Bid recommendations for various controls such as targeting expressions, keyword bids, placement bid adjustments, audience bids, and other bid optimization opportunities. Requires BidRecommendationTypeDetails to specify the recommendation context. |
| `BRAND_PRODUCT_SEGMENT` | Recommends product groups within a brand that shoppers search for as a distinct need. Requires BrandProductSegmentRecommendationTypeDetails to scope by brand. |
| `BRAND_PRODUCT_KEYWORD` | Recommends keywords and bids for brand product segments. Requires BrandProductKeywordRecommendationTypeDetails to scope by brand and inclusions. |
RecommendationTypeEnumQuery.name: recommendationTypeEnum

productId.description: The identifier of the advertised product.

Bid.description: A unified bid recommendation for various controls such as a targeting expression, theme based, placement, audiences etc.

BidAnalysis.description: Analysis of a specific bid value with estimated impression impact

BidAnalysisType.description:
The type of bid in a bid analysis
**BidAnalysisType Enum:**

| BidAnalysisType | Description |
|------|------|
| `ALTERNATIVE` | An alternative bid included in the analysis |
| `SUGGESTED_LOWER` | The lower bound for the suggested bid |
| `SUGGESTED_UPPER` | The upper bound for the suggested bid |
| `SUGGESTED` | The suggested bid value |

BidImpactMetrics.description: Expected impact metrics for bid recommendations

BidRecommendationScope.description:
Further refines the bid recommendation context.
**BidRecommendationScope Enum:**

| BidRecommendationScope | Description |
|------|------|
| `EXISTING_AD_GROUP` | Bid recommendations for an existing ad group. |
| `KEYWORD_AND_TARGET` | Bid recommendations for keywords, product targets, or theme targets. |
| `NEW_AD_GROUP` | Bid recommendations for a new ad group. |

BidRecommendationTarget.description: The subset of target details applicable to bid recommendations.

BidRecommendationTheme.description:
Theme or occasion context for bid recommendations.
**BidRecommendationTheme Enum:**

| BidRecommendationTheme | Description |
|------|------|
| `BFCM_HOLIDAY` | Bid recommendations for Black Friday / Cyber Monday holiday event |
| `CONVERSION_OPPORTUNITIES` | Bid recommendations for conversion optimization |
| `FALL_PRIME_DEAL_EVENT` | Bid recommendations for Fall Prime Deal event |
| `PRIME_DAY` | Bid recommendations for Prime Day event |

BidRecommendationTypeDetails.description: Context for bid recommendations across various bids, e.g. targeting/keyword, placement, audience bid adjustments.

adGroupId.description: The ad group reference. Used for existing ad group bid recommendations.

campaignIds.description: Campaign references. For existing ad group bids, provide a single campaign. For placement bid adjustments, provide one or more campaigns.

includeAnalysis.description: Flag to include detailed bid analyzer data in the response. When true, bidAnalysis will be populated in Bid.

productDetailsList.description: Supplemental GlobalStore metadata for ASINs listed in the asins field. Each entry's asin must be present in asins. Used when scope is NEW_AD_GROUP.

productIds.description: List of Products, e.g. ASINs for the new ad group. Used when scope is NEW_AD_GROUP. productDetailsList provides supplemental GlobalStore metadata for a subset of these ASINs.

siteRestrictions.description: Optional site restrictions indicating the campaign targets a restricted site (e.g. AMAZON_BUSINESS). When present, bid recommendations are calibrated for that site's traffic characteristics. Mirrors the siteRestrictions field on Campaign.

targets.description: List of targets for which bid recommendations are requested. Covers keyword, auto, product, and theme targeting. Total count must not exceed 100.

BidStrategy.description:
**BidStrategy Enum:**

| BidStrategy | Description |
|------|------|
| `MANUAL` | Uses your exact bid and any placement adjustments you set, and is not subject to dynamic bidding. |
| `RULE_BASED` | Applies bidding rules defined by the advertiser. |
| `SALES_DOWN_ONLY` | Decreases your bids in real time when your ad is less likely to convert to a sale. Bids will never increase beyond your set bid. |
| `SALES_UP_AND_DOWN` | Increases or decreases your bids in real time by a maximum of 100%. With this setting bids increase when your ad is more likely to convert to a sale, and bids decrease when less likely to convert to a sale. |

BidValueRange.description: A suggested bid value and range. suggested is the recommended amount; lower and upper provide the low and high bounds.

lower.description: Lower bound of the suggested bid range.

upper.description: Upper bound of the suggested bid range.

BiddingConfiguration.description: Bidding control configuration for bid recommendation requests

adjustments.description: Placement bid adjustment configuration for the campaign.

BrandProductKeywordRecommendationTypeDet.description: Request details for brand product keyword recommendations.

brandId.description: The brand identifier to scope keyword recommendations.

brandName.description: The brand name to scope keyword recommendations.

BrandProductKeywordSettings.description: A recommended brand product keyword with bid guidance.

keywordTheme.description: The theme classification of the keyword (e.g. Generic, Branded, Seasonal).

BrandProductSegmentRecommendationTypeDet.description: Request details for brand product segment recommendations.

brandId.description: The brand identifier to scope segment recommendations.

brandName.description: The brand name to scope segment recommendations.

brandProductSegmentId.description: The identifier of the brand product segment (a ProductCategory type).

isTopPick.description: Whether this segment is a featured recommendation.

previewProductIds.description: Product identifiers for previewing this segment.

productCount.description: Number of products in this segment for the brand.
